gemini.title: Risk of Flooding from Surface Water - Model Origin
gemini.abstract: Areas identifying the model source and vintage used in the national Risk of Flooding from Surface Water mapping.
gemini.lineage: Published by Environment Agency as open environmental data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: model
columns.description: Name or description of the flood model that produced the feature.

columns.name: scale
columns.description: Geographic scale of the model, such as National.

columns.name: model_year
columns.description: Year associated with the flood-model version or run.

columns.name: flood_source
columns.description: Source of flooding represented, such as river, sea or surface water.

columns.name: uuid
columns.description: Globally unique identifier for the model-origin record.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
